questions.q:
Match the following:

\begin{array}{|l|l|}
\hline
\text{\textbf{Column-I}} & \text{\textbf{Column-II}} \\
\hline
\text{(A) If } \displaystyle \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{\log \sin x}{\cos^2 x} \, dx = -K \text{ then the value of } \frac{3K}{\pi} \text{ is greater than} & \text{(P) } 0 \\
\hline
\text{(B) If } e^{x+y} + e^{y-x} = 1 \text{ and } y'' - (y')^2 + K = 0\text{, then } K \text{ is equal to} & \text{(Q) } 1 \\
\hline
\text{(C) If } f(x) = x \ln x \text{ then } 2(f^{-1})'(\ln 4) \text{ is more than} & \text{(R) } 2 \\
\hline
\text{(D) } \displaystyle \lim_{x \to \infty} (x \ln x)^{\frac{1}{x^2+1}} \text{ is less than} & \text{(S) } 4 \\
\hline
& \text{(T) } 5 \\
\hline
\end{array}

questions.q:
Let $\displaystyle f(x) = \begin{cases} [x] & , -2 \le x < 0 \\ |x| & , 0 \le x \le 2 \end{cases}$ (where $[\cdot]$ denotes the greatest integer function) and $\displaystyle g(x) = \sec x, x \in R - (2n+1)\frac{\pi}{2}, n \in I$.

Match the following statements in Column-I with their values in Column-II in the interval $\displaystyle \left(-\frac{3\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right)$:

\begin{array}{|l|l|}
\hline
\text{\textbf{Column-I}} & \text{\textbf{Column-II}} \\
\hline
\text{(A) Abscissa of points where limit of } (f \circ g)(x) \text{ exist is/are} & \text{(P) } -1 \\
\hline
\text{(B) Abscissa of points in domain of } (g \circ f)(x)\text{, where limit of } (g \circ f)(x) \text{ does not exist is/are} & \text{(Q) } \pi \\
\hline
\text{(C) Abscissa of points of discontinuity of } (f \circ g)(x) \text{ is/are} & \text{(R) } \displaystyle \frac{5\pi}{6} \\
\hline
\text{(D) Abscissa of points of differentiability of } (f \circ g)(x) \text{ is/are} & \text{(S) } -\pi \\
\hline
& \text{(T) } 0 \\
\hline
\end{array}
questions.source: Black Book · Continuity and Differentiability · Exercise 4: Matrix Match Type Problems · Q2

questions.q:
Let a function $f(x) = [x]\{x\} - |x|$ where $[\cdot]$, $\{\cdot\}$ are greatest integer and fractional part respectively. Match the following Column-I with Column-II in domain $(-3, \infty)$:

\begin{array}{|l|l|}
\hline
\text{\textbf{Column-I}} & \text{\textbf{Column-II}} \\
\hline
\text{(A) } f(x) \text{ is continuous at } x \text{ equal to} & \text{(P) } 3 \\
\hline
\text{(B) } \left| \frac{4}{3} \displaystyle \int_{2}^{3} f(x) \, dx \right| \text{ is equal to} & \text{(Q) } 1 \\
\hline
\text{(C) If } g(x) = x - 1 \text{ and if } f(x) = g(x)\text{, then number of solutions is} & \text{(R) } 4 \\
\hline
\text{(D) If } l = \displaystyle \lim_{x \to 4^+} f(x)\text{, then } -l \text{ is equal to} & \text{(S) } 2 \\
\hline
\end{array}

questions.q:
Let the function:
f(x) = \begin{cases} ax(x-1) + b & ; \quad x < 1 \\ x - 1 & ; \quad 1 \le x \le 3 \\ px^2 + qx + 2 & ; \quad x > 3 \end{cases}
If $f(x)$ is continuous for all $x$, $f'(1)$ does not exist, and $f'(x)$ is continuous at $x = 3$.

Match the values in Column-I with Column-II:

\begin{array}{|l|l|}
\hline
\text{\textbf{Column-I}} & \text{\textbf{Column-II}} \\
\hline
\text{(A) } a \text{ cannot have value} & \text{(P) } 1/3 \\
\hline
\text{(B) } b \text{ has value} & \text{(Q) } 0 \\
\hline
\text{(C) } p \text{ has value} & \text{(R) } -1 \\
\hline
\text{(D) } q \text{ has value} & \text{(S) } 1 \\
\hline
\end{array}
questions.source: Black Book · Continuity and Differentiability · Exercise 4: Matrix Match Type Problems · Q5
